# REM PhysicalAI

> A self-learning system for robots: it learns by itself, dreams in a
> physics simulation while it sleeps, verifies every new model against
> fixed probes, and wakes up better. Built for the Arduino Ventuno Q
> (not yet on sale). All inference on-device with ExecuTorch; no cloud.

For AI agents: start with AGENTS.md in this repository — it is the
operating contract (deploy steps, board facts, invariants).

## Docs

- [Self-improvement, fast](docs/SELF-IMPROVEMENT.md): start the learning loop, teach it, prove it — five minutes
- [How it works](docs/HOW-IT-WORKS.md): the concepts, in plain words
- [Setup on the Ventuno Q](docs/SETUP.md): running in minutes
- [Commands](docs/COMMANDS.md): chat commands, teaching, camera teaching
- [Implement with an agent](docs/FOR-AGENTS.md): agent + human, zero to dreaming, with a verification checklist
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): instructions for coding agents working in this repo

## Key entry points

- Deploy: `./quickstart.sh` (then flash `examples/walkersense/walker_bridge` via serial)
- Interface: `system/dashboard.py` → http://<board>:8080
- Dream engine: `system/idle_learn.py`
- Teaching: `system/teach.py` (add / retrain)
- Dream world: `dreamworld/dream_sim.py`, `dreamworld/dream_replay.py`
